summary: Veteran Caregiver Reeducation, Reemployment, and Retirement Act This bill expands support and assistance provided to family caregivers under the Program of Comprehensive Assistance for Family Caregivers administered by the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). First, the bill extends the period of medical care coverage for primary family caregivers to include the 180-day period following the removal of their designation as a caregiver under the program, unless such individuals (1) were dismissed from the program for fraud, abuse, or mistreatment; or (2) are entitled to Medicare. Next, the VA must provide bereavement counseling and support to family caregivers following the death of a veteran receiving care under the program.
